description: Which health insurance deductible (franchise) pays off: for a commune or premium region, age group, model and expected yearly health costs, the yearly premiums plus cost sharing (deductible + 10 % up to CHF 700, children CHF 350, KVG) for every deductible, the cheapest choice and the break-even between the lowest and highest deductible. Hospital contribution and the 40 % share on some medicines are not included.

accident.description: accident cover included (default true; employees 8+ h a week are covered by the employer)

expected_costs.description: expected health costs per year in CHF (doctor, medicines, hospital, therapy), default 1000

insurer.description: one insurer by name, optional (default: the cheapest offer per deductible)

name: health_deductible_advice
